messages:
Nadia: New onboarding ticket: users confused about which env var to set for the CLI vs SDK. Sample app uses REDWOOD_API_KEY but docs show REDWOOD_TOKEN. They hit 401s.
Evan: I can repro. CLI parses --api-key and env REDWOOD_TOKEN; SDK reads REDWOOD_API_KEY. Total mismatch.
Priya: We should pick one canonical name and deprecate the other. Propose REDWOOD_API_KEY as canonical, keep REDWOOD_TOKEN as alias for 6 months with warnings.
Nadia: Also need consistent precedence: flags > env > creds file > metadata. Put that in quickstart and SDK README.
Evan: For rotation: on 401 try one refresh if a refresh token exists, else show actionable error "token expired: run `redwood auth login` or set REDWOOD_API_KEY". Avoid retry storms.
Priya: Add a small client-side check: if endpoint looks org-admin and key looks project-scoped, return helpful error instead of opaque 403.
tool-bot: deploy: pushing CLI v0.19.2-beta with --cred-debug (prints cred source without values) and telemetry event cred_source.
Nadia: Can someone file the deprecation RFC for REDWOOD_TOKEN and update sample-apps to use flags in CI?
Evan: I'll open the RFC and a small SDK PR to log warnings for deprecated vars.
Priya: I'll update sample-app and the retry handler.
